note: Instructions and all 4 statements transcribed verbatim from the study's own CC BY S1 Appendix; '1.'..'4.' numbering stripped; the parenthetical '(each item is 1=strongly disagree, 5=strongly agree; a=0.87, M=2.78, SD=0.97)' dropped from instructions and its trailing colon replaced by a period. Codes: data/enders_2022_conspiracy_vaccine.py keeps the Qualtrics names VICTIM_1..4 (VICTIM_5, constant across all respondents, dropped as an embedded attention check); the deposit has no question-text row or codebook and the appendix numbers statements without naming codes, so the tie is appendix listing order (paper_order). Caution: sibling batch_568 found this appendix's CTSCALE listing order did NOT match code order, so order alone was not trusted. Checks (verify_enders_2022_victimhood.R): scale alpha/M/SD 0.870/2.781/0.969 vs published .87/2.78/.97 (reversed mean would be 3.219); direction: r with COVID misinformation +0.297 and with COVID conspiracy beliefs +0.283 vs SI Table A2 +0.295/+0.281, so resp 5 = strongly agree as printed. Mapping: Armaly & Enders fielded the same 4 statements (same printed order) as q2_1,q2_2,q2_3,q2_5 in their CC0 2019 data; re-running their Table 1 CFA reproduces EGO loadings .803/.797/.736/.752 and chi2 40.58 exactly, and their ESM Figure A2 wording-labelled histograms match per-code % (e.g. q2_3 = settle for less, 30.1% at 4). Scoring all 24 assignments of those labelled statements to VICTIM_1..4 on centred means, loadings and inter-item r: shipped order ranks 1 (0.024); the three within-pair swaps rank 2-4 (0.030, 0.042, 0.047); every other assignment >= 0.110. So the partition {1,2}={deserve, great things} vs {3,4}={settle, extra break} is pinned; order within each pair rests on listing order. Only endpoints labelled in the source; resp 2-4 option_text blank. Rights: instrument is Armaly & Enders' own (Enders is a co-author here), wording from the CC BY appendix; no instrument_rights_register.csv row; no fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution clause found on either source (the PMC article's Springer copyright line is a notice on the article, not terms on the items) -- silence, not a positive grant; no register row written.
